purpose: Review the three AR-06 improvement claims against source, saved assets, and official public training aggregates.
hypothesis: Some proposals already exist; lookup safety and global phonetic retrieval require separate designs and measurement.
fixed_conditions: Read-only audit; no fitting, matcher execution, inference, or ZIP generation.

code.dirty_scope: Source, assets and ZIPs unchanged; new audit documentation and aggregates added.

data.split_id: G5-s42 and row5-s42 auxiliary; structure inspection only

retrieval.indexes: exact, name prefix, skeleton prefix, phonetic prefix, word prefix, number; not a global all-position n-gram index

model.type: AR-06 rule matcher; inspected, not executed

commands: PowerShell 7: Import-Csv public train; trim/uppercase callsign; count distinct target IDs per key and compare every row with saved callsign_lookup.
PowerShell 7: group fixed G5 and row5 split rows by target ID; count distinct folds per ID.
PowerShell 7: Get-Content source and model JSON; Get-FileHash SHA256 for code/data/folds/assets.
observations: Current JSON false overrides a changed USE_TRAIN_LOOKUP fallback constant.
Current lookup stores majority IDs and returns immediately; not an implemented safe lookup policy.
5851 distinct training callsigns; zero multi-ID keys or saved lookup disagreements across 12222 rows.
Hangul retrieval already unions unlimited GT and IGT windows at rel_tol 0.098.
Skeleton and phonetic compatibility mappings already exist; global all-position n-grams would be a distinct addition.
Saved assets include train word/syllable maps and callsign/name lookup; both current JSON copies have equal hashes.
Tonnage <=1.5 percent already receives positive scores; an extra conditioned bonus is a separate hypothesis.
interpretations: The three claims do not establish causes of the official leaderboard plateau.
Prioritize explicit safe lookup policy and global retrieval comparisons; keep tonnage interaction as a separate factor.
limitations: Private test overlap and failure causes cannot be established from leaderboard score.
Current Windows .venv-server is absent; the historical Linux environment report does not establish the current PC environment.
decision: Complete source/asset audit and corrected implementation design; preserve current matcher, model assets and ZIPs. No unrequested model experiment.
next_actions: If implementation is requested, separate run_ar06 ZIP creation from evaluation and fitting.
Implement fold-fitted safe lookup schema and explicit policy; validate G5 regression and row5 seen/unseen slices separately.
Compare global character n-gram union with the existing scorer fixed, then global skeleton retrieval as another factor.
Compare conditioned tonnage/meta bonus only with fixed candidates.

results.scope: Static source and JSON audit; public-training and split aggregate checks in PowerShell only. No model execution or private test inspection.
